prompt.alinti: Motion to Mixamo Rig is the motion capture tool that turns ordinary video clips into professional character animations without a motion lab. It watches a single person moving on camera and calculates their exact body pose frame by frame. The software then transfers those movements onto a three-dimensional character model you can download from Adobe Mixamo. This means you can make a digital robot or superhero dance by simply recording yourself on a phone. The tool even works with still photos to create static poses. It is a powerful way for independent creators to bring characters to life using just a camera and a computer.
